title: God Puts His Name on Us

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: 'So they will put my name on the Israelites, and I will bless them.' - Num 6:27 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This final verse tells us what the blessing actually does: through it, God puts His name on His people. And then He adds a wonderful promise: "and I will bless them." The blessing was never merely the priests' good wishes. It was God Himself placing His name upon His people and pledging to bless them.

To have God's name placed on you means you belong to Him. In the ancient world, a name spoke of ownership, identity, and relationship. When God put His name on Israel, He was declaring, "These are Mine." They carried His name as a mark of belonging.

What an astonishing grace. The God of all creation stamps His own name upon ordinary people and calls them His own. And the blessing does not stop at words; God Himself stands behind it: "I will bless them." His promise makes it sure.

This belonging is gloriously true for all who are in Christ. We are baptised into the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matt 28:19). We are called children of God, bearing His name (1 John 3:1). And there is a day coming when His people will see His face, and "his name will be on their foreheads" (Rev 22:4).

You are not your own. If you belong to Christ, God has put His name on you. You carry His identity, you enjoy His blessing, and you are His forever.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What does it mean to you that God has put His name on you?
- How does belonging to God shape your identity?
- How can you live today as one who carries God's name?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for putting Your name on me and calling me Your own. Help me to live today as one who belongs to You and carries Your name with honour. Amen.
